messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: integrate_ode_cvode
parts:
We already decided that's not the name we want.

Can we rename before we release 2.10?

The current plan is to use algorithm name
abbreviations, not software package names.

- Bob

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: integrate_ode_cvode
parts:
Oh, we cross posted. YES! I suggest to rename integrate_ode_cvode to integrate_ode_bdf. We will then just change the implementation used with, hopefully, 2.11 to the implementation which is on the cvodes pull request.

... and I can offer to write some doc about it.

Sebastian
